interface.name: zwwm_edge_swipe_manager_v1
interface.description: Lets a shell follow touch swipes that start at an output edge. The compositor recognises the swipe and keeps the touch sequence away from other clients; the shell only animates and decides what the swipe does.

request.name: get_edge_swipe

description.summary: listen for swipes from the given edges

request.description: Touches that start within the configured edge zone of any edge in `edges` become swipes delivered to this object instead of clients.

interface.name: zwwm_edge_swipe_v1
interface.description: Each swipe is one began event, any number of progress events, then exactly one ended event. Offsets are logical pixels from the touch-down point, positive towards the inside of the output for the swipe's edge.

arg.name: velocity
arg.summary: logical pixels per second along the swipe
